newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada approves Scotibank Nat Trust bid.
newsitem.headline: Canada approves Scotibank Nat Trust bid.

text.p: The Canadian government said on Tuesday it had approved Bank of Nova Scotia's C$1.25 billion bid to acquire Toronto-based National Trustco Co.

"The decision was taken after the superintendent of financial institutions had completed his review and recommended that the transaction be approved," Jim Peterson, secretary of state (international financial institutions), said in a statement.
Scotiabank's offer to acquire all outstanding shares in Canada's last big family-owned trust, is scheduled to expire on August 11.
The cash and stock deal is valued at C$1.25 billion.
